```yaml
name: Security Scan

# v4.2.2
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 9 * * 1' # Runs weekly on Mondays at 9:00 JST

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run security scan
        id: security-scan
        run: npm run security-scan

      - name: Send email notification
        if: ${{ success() }}
        uses: dawidd6/action-send-mail@2cea9617b09d79a095af21254fbcb7ae95903dde
        with:
          server_address: smtp.resend.com
          server_port: 587
          secure: true
          username: ${{ secrets.RESEND_API_KEY }}
          from: ${{ secrets.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL }}
          to: ${{ secrets.SECURITY_SCAN_RECIPIENT }}
          subject: Security Scan Results - ${date +%Y-%m-%d}
          body: ${{ steps.security-scan.outputs.email-body }}

      - name: Send email notification on failure
        if: ${{ failure() }}
        uses: dawidd6/action-send-mail@2cea9617b09d79a095af21254fbcb7ae95903dde
        with:
          server_address: smtp.resend.com
          server_port: 587
          secure: true
          username: ${{ secrets.RESEND_API_KEY }}
          from: ${{ secrets.RESEND_FROM_EMAIL }}
          to: ${{ secrets.SECURITY_SCAN_RECIPIENT }}
          subject: Security Scan Failed - ${date +%Y-%m-%d}
          body: The security scan failed. Please check the logs for details.
```

This GitHub Actions workflow performs a security scan on `.toon` files using the OpenRouter API and sends email notifications via Resend. It runs weekly on Mondays at 9:00 JST and has a timeout of 60 minutes. The workflow includes steps for checking out the repository, setting up Node.js, installing dependencies, running the security scan, and sending email notifications based on the scan results.
